With these precedents in hand, we commenced our study by
examining the reaction of ethyl 2-(2-nitro-1-phenylethyl) buta-
2,3-dienoate 1a with CsF in CH 3CN at room temperature. To
our surprise, the substrate underwent an unexpected intra-
molecular cascade reaction to form 5-hydroxy-3-pyrrolin-2-one
2a in 66% yield ( Table 1 , entry 1). This unprecedented result
prompted us to screen the reaction parameters in greater detail
to improve the reaction e ﬃciency. Preliminary solvent
screening indicated that CH
3CN was optimal among a variety
of solvents (entries 1 −8). Subsequently, the in ﬂuence of
various organic and

use of inorganic bases such as t-BuOK,

yields, while Cs 2CO3 gave a better yield, in short reaction time

when the reaction was tried using organic bases such as DMAP
and DABCO (entries 14,15). The product 2a was obtained
only in low yield when we attempted to render the reaction
substoichiometric by employing 0.5 equiv of Cs
2CO3 (entry
16). Moreover, no product yield enhancement was observed
when the reaction was carried out at a higher temperature.
